IDENTITY AND LOOK — Two adult Chinese women, both 28, share a sunlit conservatory breakfast nook. Primary woman Lin Yue has an oval face with high cheekbones, a delicate straight nose, softly full lips with a defined cupid's bow, and clear large almond eyes in warm brown. Her luminous ivory skin shows fine pores and soft peach fuzz along the jaw. Long black hair falls in loose waves past her shoulders with face-framing wisps and backlit flyaways. She is bare-breasted through her deliberately unbuttoned champagne silk charmeuse robe, its luminous satin draping open to reveal sheer black lace bodysuit panels with scalloped edges trimmed in pearl thread across her torso and hips; pearl-trimmed silk garters secure sheer thigh-high stockings. MAKEUP — Luminous sheer base with satin finish, peach cream blush high on the cheekbones diffused toward the temples, softly arched brows with feathered hair direction brushed upward, warm taupe eyeshadow across the lid deepening to bronze in the crease with champagne pearl at the inner corner, fine black liquid eyeliner ending in a subtle flick, separated dense upper lashes with defined lower lashes, restrained highlight at the cheekbone and nose bridge, and glossy coral-pink gradient lips with soft edges. Her accessories center on a sculptural gold hair comb set with freshwater pearls securing the left temple wave, paired with layered fine gold chains at her throat and a slim gold cuff on her right wrist. Her companion Wei Ran possesses a heart-shaped face with a gentle pointed chin, small refined nose, and expressive dark eyes. Her smooth warm-toned skin carries subtle natural variation. A glossy blunt bob at jaw length frames her face with a deep side part and tucked-behind-ear detail on the left. She wears an emerald velvet wrap dress with deep cowl back exposing her shoulder blades, fitted waist, side cutouts at the ribs, and embroidered mesh panels with metallic thread floral motifs across the upper chest and skirt hem; the velvet's plush pile catches light against the sheer mesh. MAKEUP — Dewy skin tint with softly powdered T-zone, muted mauve cream blush below the cheek ridge blended outward, straight full brows with soft density, lavender eyeshadow across the lid with deeper plum at the outer corner and pearl shimmer on the brow bone, thin brown eyeliner hugging the upper lash line, fluttery separated lashes, subtle highlight at the cupid's bow and inner corner, and satin berry lips with blurred edges. Her accessories feature a wide-brimmed natural straw hat with ivory silk ribbon tilted back to reveal her face and eyes, paired with sculptural gold drop earrings of abstract botanical form and a jeweled hand chain connecting her right middle finger to wrist with small emerald-set links. The conservatory shows trailing English ivy cascading from a wrought-iron shelf above, a round marble-topped bistro table with soft grey veining, and a complete French press coffee service with warm amber liquid visible through glass. EYES AND EMOTION — Lin Yue's gaze targets Wei Ran's reflected eyes in the glass carafe surface between them, her irises angled slightly downward with relaxed upper lids, gently engaged lower lids creating luminous half-lidded warmth, smooth space between her brows, and two large soft catchlights from the broad window behind Wei Ran. Brow signal: level with minimal tension releasing toward the outer corners. Eyelid signal: upper lids lowered to one-third coverage, lower lids slightly raised in sustained attention. Cheek signal: soft lift compressing the peach blush into a warmer concentration. Mouth signal: lips barely parted with inner moisture catching light, corners lifted in a held almost-smile. Concrete trigger: the shared warmth of morning light on her exposed shoulder and the familiar scent of coffee rising between them. Primary emotion: languid ease, visible in dropped shoulders, weight surrendered against the wicker chair back, and lingering fingertips. Secondary emotion: affectionate attention, shown through sustained gaze on Wei Ran despite the lowered lids and the imperceptible lean forward across the table. Wei Ran meets this gaze directly through the carafe reflection, her irises angled slightly upward, both eyes wide with bright focused warmth, lifted inner brows creating gentle openness, and matching dual window catchlights. Brow signal: inner brows subtly raised, outer brows level. Eyelid signal: upper lids at full openness with fine lid creases visible. Cheek signal: moderate lift with faint visible warmth beneath the mauve blush. Mouth signal: soft closed lips with natural fullness, corners relaxed upward. Her primary emotion: warm recognition, the beginning of a smile held in check by absorbed attention. Secondary emotion: gentle curiosity, seen in the slight forward tilt of her chin and the attentive parting of her lips. POSE AND ACTION — Lin Yue sits in a relaxed diagonal posture across the marble table, her left hip angled toward the window and her torso opening toward Wei Ran, supported by a curved natural wicker chair with woven detail visible at her shoulders. Her left hand rests on the table edge with fingers loosely curved, thumb tracing the warm glass carafe base, feeling the residual heat diffuse through the thin walls. Her right hand extends across the table surface, index and middle fingertips extended to meet Wei Ran's approaching fingers, the contact point precisely at the carafe's center where a small pool of condensed steam has formed. Wei Ran mirrors this reach from her seated position on the opposite wicker chair, her body turned three-quarters toward Lin Yue with her weight on her left hip, right shoulder dropped slightly forward. Her right hand extends palm-down with index finger extended to touch Lin Yue's fingertips, the contact light enough that her emerald hand chain links rest softly against the marble without tension. Her left hand cups the carafe handle at its midpoint, the glass surface leaving a faint oval of warmth against her palm. The decisive action instant: both women's fingertips meet through the thin film of condensation on the marble, the slight pressure causing the moisture to spread into an irregular organic shape between them, while Wei Ran's left hand tilts the carafe infinitesimally so the amber liquid inside rocks in a slow viscous wave that catches the window light. Material consequence: a single droplet of condensed steam falls from the carafe spout onto the marble, spreading into a small transparent circle that distorts the veining beneath. CAMERA AND LIGHT — A full-body timer portrait from a shelf-mounted camera positioned at seated eye level between the two women, capturing both complete figures from crown to stocking feet. The camera sits on a low white lacquered shelf behind the actual table center, programmed to capture after a ten-second delay; the women hold their pose with natural breath. Both subjects occupy roughly 75 percent of frame height, with Lin Yue's left foot visible in a silk mule slide and Wei Ran's bare feet grounded on terra cotta tile. Three depth planes: in the near plane, the curved edge of the marble table and Lin Yue's extended forearm create soft diagonal leading lines; the middle plane holds both women in balanced symmetry around the carafe; the background plane shows the conservatory's tall arched windows with sheer cream curtains diffusing morning light, the ivy shelf, and a blurred glimpse of potted orchids. The high-key light source is a broad east-facing window with sheer curtain diffusion, filling both faces evenly with luminous cream-toned daylight. Soft golden-hour backlight from a slightly opened side window creates a translucent rim around Lin Yue's loose hair and the velvet nap of Wei Ran's shoulder. Palette: warm ivory and champagne against emerald and black, grounded by terracotta floor and green ivy, with restrained coral and berry accents in the makeup. Key details: the pearl trim on Lin Yue's bodice edge catches pinpoint highlights; Wei Ran's velvet pile shows individual fiber direction; the French press glass carries fine water droplet condensation; ivy leaves at the upper frame edge show individual lobed shapes against the bright curtain.

IDENTITY AND LOOK — Two adult Chinese women, twenty-seven and twenty-nine, share a paint-flecked art corner in a sunlit Beijing loft. The primary woman, Mei-Lin, has an oval face with high cheekbones, a delicate straight nose, softly full lips with a defined cupid's bow, and luminous warm ivory skin. Her large almond-shaped eyes are dark brown with fine amber flecks near the iris rim. Her long black hair is swept into a loose side-swept updo with face-framing wisps and a few paint-dusted flyaways catching the window light. MAKEUP — She wears a luminous sheer satin base, peach cream blush blended high across her cheekbones and diffused toward her temples, softly arched brows with feathered hair direction and clear brow gel finish, warm bronze eyeshadow across the lid with deeper terracotta in the crease and a pearl inner-corner highlight, thin black liquid eyeliner winged slightly upward, separated full eyelashes with individual lash definition, and glossy coral-pink lips with a soft gradient center. Her paint-splattered cropped brocade jacket in coral and gold thread features three-dimensional floral appliqué and scalloped hem edges; beneath it sits a jeweled bikini-inspired top with crystal accents catching prismatic light. High-waisted draped silk trousers in champagne pool softly at her waist. Three accessories: a sculptural gold hair comb set at her updo's base, mismatched pearl and crystal drop earrings with one longer chandelier piece, and a slim gold cuff bracelet on her right wrist. Her companion, Jia-Ru, twenty-nine, has a heart-shaped face with a gently rounded jaw, smaller dark brown eyes with warm cognac rings, and smooth fair ivory skin with faint rose undertones. Her shoulder-length black hair is worn in a glossy bob with subtle inward curve at the ends, one side tucked behind her ear revealing a delicate helix. MAKEUP — Jia-Ru wears a dewy skin tint with soft powdering at the T-zone, rose blush pressed across the apples of her cheeks and blended toward the ear, naturally dense straight brows with soft ash-brown tint, lavender-gray eyeshadow wash across the lid with deeper mauve at the outer V and silver shimmer at the inner corner, fine brown eyeliner drawn tight to the lash line with a short upward flick, feathery separated lashes, a restrained pearl highlight at her cheekbone peak, and matte berry-rose lips with a satin moisture finish. Her off-shoulder ivory lace blouse has sheer blouson sleeves gathered at the wrist with pearl buttons, the neckline resting low across her collarbones. Fitted charcoal velvet trousers with a subtle bootcut shape complete her look. Her accessories: a velvet ribbon choker with a small art-nouveau gold pendant, fine gold hoop earrings with a single freshwater pearl drop, and a vintage gold signet ring on her left ring finger. The art corner shows a large stretched canvas on a wooden easel with swaths of coral and celadon underpainting, ceramic jars bristling with hog-hair and sable brushes, and a rumpled linen drop cloth with scattered cadmium and ultramarine stains across the painted wooden floor. EYES AND EMOTION — Mei-Lin's right cheek presses against Jia-Ru's left temple; her gaze targets the phone preview screen held at arm's length, irises converging slightly downward and inward, upper lids relaxed with a gentle visible fold, lower lids softly engaged, brows level with minimal asymmetry, two large rectangular catchlights from the broad north-facing window reflected in her dark irises. Jia-Ru's face turns slightly toward Mei-Lin's jaw, her eyes finding the same phone preview with warm direct attention, irises similarly converged, lids softly lifted, a faint asymmetric elevation at her left brow suggesting sustained pleasure, clean matching catchlights. Mei-Lin's micro-expression: relaxed brow, gentle cheek lift from the pressed contact, soft lip-corner elevation barely breaking her coral gradient, a barely perceptible exhale widening her nostrils slightly. Jia-Ru mirrors with: softened brow, fuller cheek compression against Mei's face, lips parted a breath with visible inner lip moisture, a subtle chin tuck toward the contact. Concrete trigger: the shared intimacy of capturing their mutual presence in the selfie frame. Primary emotion: affectionate attention. Secondary emotion: bashful pleasure. POSE AND ACTION — Mei-Lin stands with weight balanced evenly, left hip slightly relaxed, her right arm extended full length holding an unbranded slim smartphone with a matte sage case, thumb steadying the lower edge, index finger hovering near the capture button. Her left hand, flecked with dried coral and gold paint at the knuckles, cups Jia-Ru's right jaw with fingertips resting at the hinge and thumb along the cheekbone, a gentle pressure that indents Jia-Ru's velvet-trousered hip where Mei-Lin's body leans in. Jia-Ru stands with her left hand resting lightly on Mei-Lin's draped silk waist, fingers slightly spread for balance, her right hand loosely touching her own collarbone as if surprised by tenderness. The phone tilts subtly toward them from the extended arm. Decisive instant: thumb hovering at capture, the moment before the shutter fires. Immediate material consequence: a small paint flake from Mei's knuckle transfers to Jia-Ru's jawline, visible as a coral-gold speck against her fair skin. CAMERA AND LIGHT — Large-half-body front-camera selfie, arm's-length distance, the phone's near edge visible as a thin sage-colored rectangle at the frame's lower right; both women occupy seventy percent of frame height from crown through upper thighs. Camera height at Mei-Lin's extended shoulder level, mild upward tilt toward their faces. Three depth planes: the phone's matte edge and Mei's paint-flecked fingers in soft near focus; the two women's complete heads, shoulders, torsos, and gesturing hands in sharp central focus; the easel canvas and brush jars softly separated behind them in cream and celadon bokeh. High-key light from a broad north-facing loft window, diffused through sheer linen curtains into a luminous cream veil that fills both faces evenly. Soft golden afternoon warmth from a high clerestory window adds translucent rim light to hair edges and shoulder contours. Restrained palette of coral, champagne, ivory, charcoal, and celadon with gold metal accents. Key details: the crystal accents at Mei's decolletage scattering tiny spectral highlights, Jia-Ru's lace sleeve transparency revealing her arm's soft tone beneath, the paint-flecked drop cloth's texture catching window light, a single hog-bristle brush in a nearby jar still holding a pearl of cadmium orange at its tip.

Her accessories are the velvet pillbox hat, a triple-strand pearl choker with a gold clasp visible at her nape, and a slim gold cuff bracelet on her right wrist. They stand in a converted Song dynasty tea room with distressed timber farm table between them, blue-and-white porcelain ginger jars and tea bowls arranged on open shelving against whitewashed brick, and two beeswax tapers in beaten brass holders casting warm pools on the table's scored surface.
